offer an apology: The airline had to offer an apology to all passengers for the long delay and give each of them a free meal.
航空公司必須為長時間延誤向所有乘客道歉，並送給每人一份免費餐點。
offer resistance: The tired soldiers could offer resistance for only a few hours before the enemy took the town.
疲憊的士兵們只能抵抗幾個小時，敵軍就占領了小鎮。
offer an explanation: When the teacher asked why he was late again, Tom could not offer an explanation and just looked down.
老師問湯姆為什麼又遲到時，他提不出解釋，只是低著頭。
offer advice: Our school counselor is always happy to offer advice to students who are worried about choosing a college.
我們學校的輔導老師總是很樂意提供建議給擔心選大學的學生。
offer a glimpse: Old diaries like this one offer a glimpse into the daily life of farmers in Taiwan a hundred years ago.
像這樣的舊日記讓人一窺一百年前台灣農夫的日常生活。
offer one's condolences: When I heard that her grandmother had passed away, I called her to offer my condolences.
當我聽說她的祖母過世時，我打電話給她致哀。
have a lot to offer: This small town may look quiet, but it has a lot to offer, including hot springs and delicious food.
這個小鎮看起來可能很安靜，但它很有價值，有溫泉和美味的食物。
omit a detail: When you write a report about the experiment, do not omit a detail, because every step is important.
寫實驗報告時，不要省略任何細節，因為每一個步驟都很重要。
omit to mention: Salespeople sometimes omit to mention that a cheap phone has no warranty, so always read the contract carefully.
推銷員有時未提及便宜手機沒有保固，所以一定要仔細閱讀合約。
be omitted from the list: Because of a printing error, her name was omitted from the list of prize winners in the school newspaper.
由於印刷錯誤，她的名字未列入校刊的得獎者名單。
open fire: The police officers were told not to open fire unless the robbers attacked them first.
警員們被告知除非搶匪先攻擊，否則不准開火。
open an account: You need your ID card and a little money if you want to open an account at the bank.
如果你想在銀行開戶，你需要身分證和一點錢。
open the door to: Learning English well can open the door to many job opportunities around the world.
學好英文可以為世界各地的許多工作機會開啟可能。
open one's eyes to: Volunteering in a poor village can open your eyes to how lucky you are to have clean water every day.
在貧窮的村莊當志工能使你認清自己每天有乾淨的水是多麼幸運。
open up: It took weeks before the shy new student felt safe enough to open up to his classmates about his problems.
過了好幾週，那位害羞的新同學才覺得夠安心，向同學敞開心扉談他的問題。
open a debate: The new law about school uniforms will surely open a debate among students, parents, and teachers.
這項關於校服的新法一定會在學生、家長和老師之間展開辯論。
open the floor: After her short speech, the speaker will open the floor and invite the audience to ask her any questions.
簡短演講後，講者會開放發言，邀請聽眾向她提出任何問題。
operate a machine: You must wear gloves and glasses when you operate a machine like this in the factory.
在工廠裡操作像這樣的機器時，你必須戴手套和護目鏡。
operate on a patient: The doctor had to operate on a patient late at night after a serious car accident.
一場嚴重車禍後，醫生必須在深夜為病人動手術。
operate a business: It is not easy to operate a business in a small town where there are only a few customers.
在只有少數顧客的小鎮經營事業並不容易。
operate within the law: All companies must operate within the law, or the government will close them down.
所有公司都必須在法律範圍內運作，否則政府會勒令它們停業。
operate on the principle: Our class library and the school bookstore operate on the principle that anyone can borrow a book if they return it.
我們班的圖書角和學校書店都以一個原則運作：只要歸還，任何人都可以借書。
oppose the plan: Many farmers oppose the plan to build a new airport on their land because they will lose their homes.
許多農民反對在他們的土地上蓋新機場的計畫，因為他們會失去家園。
be opposed to violence: Our teacher is opposed to violence of any kind and always asks us to solve problems by talking.
我們老師反對任何形式的暴力，總是要我們用溝通來解決問題。
strongly oppose: Many parents strongly oppose the idea of letting young children use smartphones without any limits.
許多家長強烈反對讓幼童毫無限制地使用智慧型手機。
as opposed to: I prefer studying in the library, as opposed to studying at home, where my little brother is always noisy.
我比較喜歡在圖書館讀書，而不是在家讀書，因為我弟弟總是很吵。
opt for the cheaper one: The two bikes looked almost the same, so I decided to opt for the cheaper one and save some money.
兩台腳踏車看起來幾乎一樣，所以我決定選擇較便宜的那台，省點錢。
opt out of: Students who are not feeling well can opt out of the long-distance run during the sports day.
身體不舒服的學生可以選擇退出運動會的長跑項目。
opt to stay: Because of the heavy typhoon, many travelers may opt to stay in their hotel instead of going sightseeing.
因為強烈颱風，許多旅客可能會選擇留在飯店，而不去觀光。
opt in: If you want to receive news about our concerts by email, you can opt in on our website.
如果你想透過電子郵件收到我們音樂會的消息，可以在我們的網站上選擇加入。
